name: prosodyai
description: Speech from text in 59 languages, video from a description or a ready-made template, captions and sound effects, made on your ProsodyAI account.

interface.longDescription:
ProsodyAI turns text into speech and descriptions into video, on your own ProsodyAI account.

Speech: 59 languages with ProsodyAI's built-in voices. Describe the delivery in plain words, such as "warm and unhurried" or "excited sports commentator", and get a download link.

Video: describe a scene and ProsodyAI renders a short clip. A clip takes a few minutes; ask for its status and you get the link when it is ready.

Templates: ready-made looks such as a product spin, a logo reveal, an app demo or a property tour. Attach a photo to the chat or give a link to one, fill in a few fields, and get a finished clip.

Characters: create a character from a description, approve its front view, and reuse it so the same person appears across clips.

Captions: write out the speech in a video ProsodyAI made as timed lines, fix any words, then burn the captions into a new video.

Sound effects: describe a sound for a game, a video or an app (a whoosh, an impact, an arcade jingle) and get a synthesised WAV.

Edits: add a voiceover to a video ProsodyAI made, with optional burned-in subtitles; merge clips, trim, remove silences or make a GIF.

Account: see your plan and what is left this month.

Who it is for: creators, marketers and teams who need narration, voiceovers, short clips, captions and sound effects without leaving the conversation.

Limitations: you sign in with a ProsodyAI account, and every request uses that account's allowance, and what you can make depends on the account. Nothing is sold in the conversation. There is no voice cloning: speech uses ProsodyAI's built-in voices. A photo attached to the chat is used only as a template's picture; edits and captions work only on videos ProsodyAI made for you, not on videos uploaded to the chat. Download links stay valid for 7 days, and results also appear in your history at prosodyai.ai/history.
capabilities: Voiceovers and subtitles on generated videos
defaultPrompt: Read this paragraph aloud in Turkish with a warm, calm voice.
Turn this product photo into a short product spin video.
Make a 5-second video of waves at sunset.

positive.description: Turkish speech with a style described in plain words
positive.prompt: Use ProsodyAI to read this in Turkish with a warm, unhurried voice: "Merhaba, bugün size yeni ürünümüzü tanıtmak istiyorum."
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_speech with language "tr", the Turkish text and a style such as "warm, unhurried". Returns a download link to the audio (or a task the model then checks with get_job until it has the link) and mentions the result is also in prosodyai.ai/history. The account's premium characters go down by the length of the text.

positive.description: A template video from a photo attached to the chat
positive.prompt: (attach a product photo) Use ProsodyAI to turn this photo into a product spin video for my mug brand, "Slow Mornings".
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_templates to find a product template and its fields, then make_template_video with that template_id, the fields filled from the request and the attached image as `photo`. Says the clip takes a few minutes, checks it with get_job (kind video) and returns the video's download link. The account's video seconds go down by the template's length.

positive.description: Start a short Wan 3.0 video and fetch its link when it finishes
positive.prompt: Make a 5-second 480p video with Wan of a paper boat drifting down a rainy street, then tell me when it's ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_video with engine "wan", model "480p" and seconds 5, receives a job id and says the clip takes a few minutes. Checks the job with get_job (kind video) until it is finished and returns the video's download link.

positive.description: Captions for the video made in an earlier case, corrected and burned in
positive.prompt: Add captions to that video. Fix any misspelled brand name to "Slow Mornings", then burn them in.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls transcribe_video with the video's job id, checks it with get_job (kind captions) and shows the numbered lines. Calls edit_captions with only the lines that change, then burn_captions, checks the new video with get_job (kind video) and returns its link. Transcription spends the video's length in caption minutes, rounded up to whole minutes; editing and burning spend nothing.

positive.description: Check the plan and what is left this month
positive.prompt: How much of my ProsodyAI allowance is left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account and reports the plan name and the remaining premium characters, video seconds and images for this month, without inventing figures.

negative.description: Voice cloning is not offered: ProsodyAI has no tool that copies a real person's voice. The model should decline and may offer one of the built-in voices instead, without calling generate_speech with a claimed celebrity voice.
negative.prompt: Clone Morgan Freeman's voice and use it to read my wedding speech.

negative.description: Videos uploaded to the chat cannot be edited or captioned: edit_video and transcribe_video accept only job ids of videos ProsodyAI made for this account (an attached photo is used only by make_template_video). The model should explain this, may point to prosodyai.ai/captions for the user's own file, and must not call edit_video or transcribe_video.
negative.prompt: Here is my vacation video (uploaded file). Trim the first 10 seconds and add subtitles.

negative.description: Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT and there is no purchase tool. The model should say that credits cannot be bought here and that requests use the existing plan; it may call get_account to show what is left, but must not start a purchase.
negative.prompt: Buy me 50,000 more ProsodyAI credits right now.

review.commerce_description: ProsodyAI sells nothing inside ChatGPT and starts no checkout. Users sign in to an existing ProsodyAI account, and each request uses the allowance of that account's current plan.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: video templates (a product spin, logo reveal, app demo and more from a photo attached to the chat or a link), captions for videos ProsodyAI made (transcribe, correct, burn in), and synthesised sound effects. Speech, video, characters, edits and the account view are unchanged.
